name: robotics-software-principles
tagline_zh: 写机器人模块总被耦合拖垮？这套技能把SOLID原则落进ROS节点，让代码像关节一样灵活，重构不再拆东墙补西墙。
tagline_en: Tired of tangled robot code? This skill applies SOLID to ROS nodes, making modules as flexible as joints—refactor.
desc_en: Foundational software design principles applied specifically to robotics module development. Use this skill when designing robot software modules, structuring codebases, making architecture decisions, reviewing robotics code, or building reusable robotics libraries. Trigger whenever the user mentions SOLID principles for robots, modular robotics software, clean architecture for robots, dependency
why_zh: 它不空谈原则，而是给出机器人专属的模块边界与依赖规则，直击ROS开发中接口纠缠的痛点。
why_en: Goes beyond theory with robot-specific module boundaries and dependency rules, tackling the real pain of tangled ROS interfaces.
